messages:
maggie: Spotted a spike in OOMs on prod region-us-east-1 ~10m ago; live profiler snapshots look noisy. Attaching quick notes and a short mitigation plan we can run now.

raj: Can you paste the profiler output? Is it allocator fragmentation or sudden workspace blowup?

maggie: Short debug dump: kernel selection flipping between cuBLAS and custom-kernel for same model run; kv-cache grows then we get sudden per-request workspace >8GB. Looks like batching heuristic chose batch_size=16 for some long-seq requests (seq>4096).

sam: Snapshot logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-17T20:12:05Z] request id=aa12 seq_len=512 batch=1 kernel=custom-opt workspace=1.1GB
[2026-03-17T20:12:07Z] request id=aa13 seq_len=4864 batch=8 kernel=autoselect -> cuBLAS workspace=9.4GB
[2026-03-17T20:12:07Z] GPU OOM on device 2, evicting kv entries tenant=internal-lowpri
[2026-03-17T20:12:07Z] circuit-breaker tripped: tenant=external-123 concurrent_long_seq=4
```

anya: Quick wins we can apply without a full rollout: 1) throttle long-seq requests (seq > 2048) to 2 concurrent; 2) enforce kernel pinning fallback order to prefer custom-opt for long seq until we stabilize; 3) set workspace_soft_limit_pct to 0.75 for the affected pool; 4) aggressive KV eviction TTL for non-hot keys.

raj: Agree. Also add an emergency request-shaper rule that reduces batch_size for seq>1024 to 2. That stops multipliers.

maggie: Proposed emergency config snippet to push via console API: 
```
{ "pool": "us-east-prod-rt-2", "overrides": { "batching": {"max_batch_size": 2, "seq_threshold": 1024}, "kernel_policy": ["custom-opt", "fallback-cublas"], "workspace_soft_limit_pct": 0.75, "kv_eviction": {"ttl_override_secs": 60, "priority_eviction": ["low", "background"]} } }
```

ted: We should also add a short-circuit circuit-breaker rule: if more than 3 long-seq requests concurrently, return 429 with `Retry-After` and route older requests to the cheaper model variant. Keeps latency SLOs.

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy queued: canary=us-east-prod-rt-2-emer-config user=maggie id=deploy-1865432145 status=queued

sam: Two operational notes from profiling: 1) kernel selection flip often happens when sequence distribution in batch is heterogeneous; our auto-selector recomputes cost with stale perf table. Short-term fix: compute kernel decision per-sample and choose conservative kernel for the batch if variance > threshold. 2) KV cache eviction currently uses LRU with global view; switch to per-tenant soft quota so one noisy tenant doesn't flush everyone.

maggie: Implemented temp rules (pushed): throttling and batch override + kernel policy. Canary logs look good for 5m. Dropped OOMs from ~12/min to 1/min. Still seeing occasional workspace spikes for sequences >6k.

anya: For sequences >4096, we should enable prefix-KV streaming: stream and evict intermediate KV slots sooner to avoid full-materialization. Config flag: `kv_streaming_window=512`.

raj: Also add a telemetry tag for these requests so we can slice by tenant/model/kernel: `oom_mitigation=live_canary_v1`

maggie: Good call. I've added telemetry tag. Current plan for next 2 hours: keep canary config, gather 30m of traces, run offline profiler to recompute kernel perf table, then push kernel-selection patch that uses per-sample cost estimate. If stable, roll to whole region.

sam: If canary fails, fallback plan: enable cpu-fallback for the largest models (route to dedicated-cpu pool) and suspend batching for that model. That will increase latency but keep system alive.

anya: Note — remember to notify support and set automated status page message if circuit-breaker triggers >5 times in 15m.

maggie: Notifying support now. @support: we might have transient errors for some customers in us-east; adding postmortem pointer and mitigation steps.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary deploy applied id=deploy-1865432145 status=success at=1865432158

raj: Early telemetry shows a 60% drop in average workspace allocation and kernel flips reduced by 80%. Nice.

maggie: Leaving this thread open. If anyone sees regression or client reports, post here. We'll capture notes for a short runbook: "live-profiler -> throttle -> kernel-pin -> kv_soft_eviction -> reassess".

sam: I'll start drafting a concise playbook entry (2-3 bullets + commands) and attach perf diffs.

anya: Thx all. :heart:

maggie: Closing action items:
- sam: perf diffs + patch for per-sample kernel cost (ETA 4h)
- raj: add telemetry slice and circuit-breaker metric alert (ETA 30m)
- anya: kv_streaming rollout plan (ETA tomorrow EOD)
- ted: 429 + routing fallback rule (ETA 1h)

maggie: last seen logs: [reduced oom rate]. will update thread when we push full kernel patch.
